pages.text: Experience reaching a sculk catalyst spreads sculk across nearby ground. The aether in experience takes a material form.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Sculk Catalyst$(br)Bottle o’ Enchanting$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: The Shape of Experience
